description: Strings that the SECRET-001 scanner MUST NOT flag. The first five are the real false positives that caused CVE-PATCHBAY-2026-0001 to be withdrawn; the rest are realistic patterns that previously tripped looser regexes.

cases.name: buywhere-product-url-slug
cases.origin: CVE-PATCHBAY-2026-0001 withdrawn — BuyWhere catalog audit JSON

cases.name: cotal-smoke-test-live-secret-material
cases.content: check("unrelated child text is not forwarded", boundStoredSessionCause("sk-live-secret-material") === "unrecognised harness failure")
cases.origin: Cotal smoke test fixture, intentionally secret-shaped literal

cases.name: cotal-fixture-must-not-surface
cases.origin: Cotal smoke test fixture, variable self-labels as fixture

cases.name: pomerado-doc-slug-in-comment
cases.content: * more digits. Slugs such as `sk-hynix-ddr5-memory-kit` or `sk-onboarding-step-2026` are not keys.
cases.origin: Pomerado own documentation explaining what their credential detector should exclude

cases.name: fodda-env-example-slack-placeholder
cases.origin: Fodda .env.example placeholder, six MCP servers affected

cases.name: generic-xxx-placeholder
cases.origin: common dummy placeholder for OpenAI key

cases.name: example-key-value-slug
cases.content: Set the env var to your real key, e.g. `OPENAI_KEY=sk-example-key-value-goes-here`.
cases.origin: doc example that labels itself as example

cases.name: slack-placeholder-alternating-dashes
cases.origin: slack placeholder with xxx segments

cases.name: too-short-dummy-sk
cases.origin: too short to be a real key, should never match

cases.name: your-openai-key-here-literal
cases.origin: placeholder user is expected to replace

cases.name: doc-comment-sk-proj-prefix
cases.content: # Use the sk-proj- prefix for project-scoped keys.
cases.origin: documentation mentioning the key prefix in prose

cases.name: product-widget-slug-contains-sk
cases.origin: product URL that happens to contain sk- segment

cases.name: stripe-live-key-prefix-only
cases.content: // stripe uses sk_live_ underscore prefix, not OpenAI's sk-
cases.origin: comment comparing prefixes, no actual secret

cases.name: all-caps-placeholder
cases.origin: ALL-CAPS placeholder segments

cases.name: shopify-tee-slug
cases.origin: SKU-like slug beginning with sk-

cases.name: constructed-key-in-test
cases.origin: runtime construction in a tests/ path, test path filter also protects

cases.name: replace-with-your-key-comment
cases.origin: placeholder comment telling user to replace

cases.name: dash-in-body-prevents-match
cases.origin: 40+ chars but dashes in body, not a real OpenAI key shape

cases.name: bare-sk-in-text
cases.content: Service keys use the sk- prefix.
cases.origin: just the prefix in prose

cases.name: slack-two-segment-no-signature
cases.origin: slack-shaped but only two segments after prefix, not a real bot token
